The '''Tyria system''' was located in the [[Hevvrol sector/Legends|Hevvrol sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Trailing" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Tyrian hydraulic strut/Legends|Tyrian hydraulic struts]], [[Tyrian violet cloth]], and [[Tyrian shimmersilk/Legends|Tyrian shimmersilk]]|system=Tyria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the pieces of technology known as [[Tyrian hydraulic strut/Legends|Tyrian hydraulic struts]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|207|Dreddon the Hutt}}</ref> as well as the fabrics known as [[Tyrian violet cloth]]<ref name="CVD">[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary (2016)|''Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary'', 2016 edition]]</ref> and [[Tyrian shimmersilk/Legends|Tyrian shimmersilk]].<ref name="FireRingRace">''[[Adventures in Hyperspace: Fire Ring Race]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tyria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first indirectly mentioned in the [[1999]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]].<ref name="Ep1ICS">''[[Star Wars: Episode I Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] first identified the system and placed it in grid square P-15.<ref name="TEA" />
